entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4676528209144882304: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 19780: distance 49.554 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.005), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 49.554 +/- 0.248 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 20.3431 +/- 0.1859 mas (same row, RUWE 4.09), 109.4 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 45.069, 42.948 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 4676528209144882304 (quality A), from 2015A&A...574A..50J; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 12.812 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 19780: radius 12.812 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 103.911 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.049) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5152 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 19780: effective temperature 5152 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.04).

entries.subject: Color

Bull. 59, 83; VizieR III/126, part2 record 35 (BS 1336), cross-checked against Gaia DR3 XP spectrum, source 4676528209144882304 (41 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffeacf. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 27256 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 1336 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 1336 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 1336 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,152 K and log g 2.56 (u1 0.584, u2 0.178): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 2.56 from 2024A&A...690A..97C; the 7 published values span log g 2.39 to 3.03, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.2% of the centre brightness.
